name: John Early
bio:
John Early (born January 21, 1988) is an American comedian, actor and singer. He has appeared on 30 Rock as Jenna Maroney's son and in the independent film Fort Tilden. He starred in Search Party, which aired on TBS and HBO Max from 2016 to 2022.

In 2025, he made his directorial debut in Maddie's Secret, where John starred as Maddie Ralph alongside long-time collaborator and comedian Kate Berlant.
